status: Independently accepted conditional whole-organization partial-health estimate
scope: One marginal unrestricted gift across employment, education, career support and strategy/reserve; whole gift costed, only employment health quantified. Existing organization revision, no new count.

financialContext.meaning: Historical functional expenditures and existing finance, not prospective allocation or marginal price. Never divide CY2025 costs by FY2024–25 DCYF participants.

allocationBasis: Central 70% integrated employment,15% education,10% additional career,5% strategy/reserve is judgment. Combined employment is about79.85% of historical program expenditure; current integrated strategy and separate streams justify a broad range, not a measured next-gift forecast. Overhead embedded in course allowances and other allocations once.
unit: An offered six-month employment place, including wages, weekly support, training, supervision, transport and allocated shared overhead. Any education/career input required for this modeled core is inside its cost; separate buckets represent other provision only.
healthBasis: Retains existing subjective .005/.02/.001 utility, effective years .5/.75/.25 and funding .5/.75/.25; not direct imported youth trial effects. Offered-place average already includes noncompletion. No second engagement multiplier.
duration: All health within one year of offer. Effective years integrate onset, decay and any within-year discount; .75 favorable is not .75 years added after the year. No lifelong employment, mortality or credential health gain.
geography: All modeled benefits assumed among Bay residents; SF share .45/.60/.25 is judgment loosely informed by SF employment accounting about45.46% of all employment costs, not measured residence. Remainder includes Oakland/San Jose/other Bay. Bay includes SF, same gift.
additionality: Access preserved or expanded because of gift versus already funded services, alternative providers and replacement of public/private commitments. Not completion or employment placement.
costPerspective: Entire $100K gift paid in every case, including unquantified/reserve shares. Cost allowances include shared operations once. Extra-resource stress adds hypothetical $100K net resources, not a measured societal cost; especially not claimed induced under no additionality. Wages are donor costs but transfers in some resource perspectives; do not subtract their full amount without pricing participant labor/time and employer production.
overlap: Single averaged health change for integrated employment/support cohort; no added QALYs from education certificates, career placements, wages, referrals or partner-clinic outcomes. Education/career spending outside core stays health-unquantified; no assumption all participants are distinct.
nullHarm: Signed shared utility scales with additionality. Independent donor-specific harm remains outside it. Nonpositive QALYs have null ratios, not apparent bargains. Null/harm demonstrate boundaries, not observed event rates.

fundingRoom.missing: Program mix, consistent dose, all-funder marginal ledger, resident mix, live capacity, and no-gift continuation/alternative service

formula: Bay gross=(employment allocation / full offered-place cost)*utility*effective years*additionality. SF=Bay gross*SFshare−independent SF harm; restBay=Bay gross*(1−SFshare)−independent restBay harm; Bay=SF+restBay. USD/10=10*whole gift/netQ if positive.
